info.title: Mishwark Backend API
info.description:
Mishwark car-rental & chauffeur booking backend.

Base URL: `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`

Authentication: JWT Bearer token from `POST /auth/otp/verify`. Protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Dev OTP bypass code: `0000`.

post.summary: Create a new employee/staff account. Multipart/form-data — fields may arrive as JSON strings or files.
Email/password login (admin & internal staff). Returns JWT cookie + user.
Public. Sends a 4-digit OTP to the phone. In dev the code is returned as dev_otp.
Public. Verifies OTP and returns a JWT. Dev bypass code: 0000. Response drives role-based home screen.
Completes a 2FA challenge during login using a temporary token.
Confirms and enables 2FA for a user.
Clears the auth cookie / current session.
Bumps tokenVersion, invalidating every session for the user.
Admin (user_password:manage). Resets a user's 2FA.

put.summary: Admin (user_password:manage). Changes a user's password and optionally resets 2FA. Protected by requirePermission.

get.summary: Returns TOTP secret + QR code data URL for authenticator enrollment.

post.summary: Validates an OTP to enable 2FA.
Disables 2FA for the authenticated user.
PUBLIC. Server-side price estimate. Never trust a client-side price.
Creates a booking with status=PENDING. DB unique constraint blocks double-booking (409).

get.summary: Cancels a booking (DELETE). Releases availability & driver and promotes waitlist position #1.

delete.summary: Cancels a booking (DELETE). Releases availability & driver and promotes waitlist position #1.

patch.summary: NOTSTARTED→INPROGRESS→ARRIVED→COMPLETED. Trip COMPLETED auto-completes the booking and releases the driver.

post.summary: POST /driver/vehicles

get.summary: PUBLIC. Returns a driver's profile by id (rating included).

post.summary: Blind rating: only visible to the other party after both submit OR 48h. Driver rating recalculated.
Creates a PENDING payment. paymentMethod: PAYMOB|FAWRY|CASH|WALLET.

patch.summary: Updates payment record and recomputes booking aggregate paymentStatus.

post.summary: POST /payments/{id}/refund
Joins the waitlist at the next open position; cancellation promotes position #1.
POST /waitlist/{id}/convert
Creates a package with a server-applied discount.
POST /packages/{id}/booking

get.summary: Auto-creates the conversation for a booking on first call.

post.summary: Auto-creates the conversation for a booking on first call.

get.summary: Sends a chat message. messageType: TEXT|QUICK_REPLY.

post.summary: Sends a chat message. messageType: TEXT|QUICK_REPLY.
Generates/returns the user's referral code.
Applies a referral code to the authenticated user.
PUBLIC. Credits both referrer & referee wallets when the refereed user completes their first booking.
Credits the wallet. type: REFERRAL_REWARD|REFUND|MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT|PAYMENT_DEDUCTION|DEPOSIT.
POST /wallet/debit

get.summary: Bookings grouped by day for a month (YYYY-MM).
Bookings filtered by a specific date (YYYY-MM-DD).
